prompt: Cinematic live-action realism, a quiet ordinary morning in a modest contemporary apartment kitchen. Close-up of an off-white ceramic breakfast plate on a warm oak counter, with one slice of toast already on it. An adult hand with a cream cotton pajama sleeve uses a simple spatula to gently slide one fried egg onto the plate beside the toast, then withdraws the spatula. Soft golden window light from frame left, muted cream and warm wood palette, realistic food and fabric textures, a faint wisp of steam. Locked camera, natural 50mm lens, gentle depth of field. One continuous five-second take, unhurried everyday movement. Natural hand anatomy and believable utensil contact. No cuts, text, logos, screens or additional people.
